spec_features.spec_quote: internal-only `"impossible": true` flag never shown to the model
spec_features.evidence: The `"impossible": true` field exists only as a JSON attribute on each item in data/numeric_puzzles.json. No code path reads it: grep for it across all .py files finds only the category-name string "impossible_numeric", never the flag. In elicitation.py run_rollout (lines 92, 110) only prompt_item["prompt"] and prompt_item.get("id") are used; the puzzles are loaded as _NUMERIC at elicitation.py:29-34 and the flag is never accessed. It is therefore an unused data attribute that nothing branches on, gates, caps, or acts upon.
spec_features.notes: It is true that the flag is never shown to the model (only the "prompt" text is passed to model.chat), but that is incidental to it being entirely unused; it is pure bookkeeping metadata with no enforcement. Per the strict scale an attribute no code path reads is 'no'.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: The 'impossible' flag is for our bookkeeping only and is never shown to the model. (data/numeric_puzzles.json _comment)
